rows.title: Sphere rolls down a ramp into a bottle
Sphere rolls into a bottle and topples a second bottle
rows.initial_state: On the table, a bottle stands upright near the near side. A second bottle stands upright farther along the same line, with a clear gap between them. A sphere rests on the table behind the first bottle, already moving toward it when the clip opens.
rows.what_happens: The sphere rolls forward on the table and hits the first bottle. The first bottle is knocked over and slides a little as it falls into the path of the second bottle. That contact makes the second bottle wobble, then tip and fall away from its starting place.
rows.counterfactual: The sphere starts in the same place, but it is at rest at t=0 instead of already moving. It does not reach the first bottle, so neither bottle is knocked over.

rows.title: Sphere rolls through a domino line
rows.initial_state: On the floor, a sphere is released already moving toward a short row of three slabs standing on their narrow edges. The first slab stands a short distance ahead of the sphere, the second stands farther along the same line, and the third stands beyond it. A bottle sits apart from the row, in the path of the last slab if it is struck. A book rests beside the bottle as a stationary obstacle. Nothing is touching at t=0.
rows.what_happens: The sphere rolls across the floor and hits the first slab. The first slab topples into the second slab, and the second slab topples into the third. The last slab then strikes the bottle, pushing it over into the book. The book is nudged and shifts slightly after the bottle hits it, while the sphere continues past the fallen slabs and slows due to friction.
rows.counterfactual: Only one thing is changed: the first slab is placed a little farther from the sphere at t=0, so the sphere no longer reaches it within the clip. The rest of the setup is unchanged, and the domino chain does not start.

rows.title: Bottle tipped by a rolling ball
rows.initial_state: A book lies flat on the floor. A bottle stands upright on the book, set well back from the edge so it is fully supported. At t=0 the ball is already moving toward the book, while the bottle is at rest.

The bottle starts to tip from the impact, then rotates away from its base and falls off the book. The ball slows after the collision and comes to rest nearby.
rows.counterfactual: The only change is that the ball starts farther away from the book. Everything else is unchanged. In that case the ball does not reach the book within the clip, so the bottle stays upright and nothing is tipped.

rows.counterfactual: Change one thing: the bottle is placed a little farther back from the sphere’s path while everything else stays the same. The sphere still rolls forward, but it misses the bottle, so the bottle remains upright.

The moving bottle then strikes the mug, pushing the mug over. After the impacts, the ball continues briefly and slows under friction while the toppled objects settle.

A bottle stands upright on the floor near the base of the table, directly in line with the end of the ramp. A sphere rests higher up on the incline, held at rest only by the ramp. The floor is below the table, and the sphere’s path from the ramp leads straight toward the bottle.
rows.what_happens: At the opening, gravity takes over and the sphere starts rolling down the incline. It leaves the low end of the ramp and drops to the floor, then continues forward and hits the bottle. The bottle is knocked over and slides or tips away while the sphere continues onward briefly after the collision.
rows.counterfactual: The same setup, except the bottle is placed farther to the side so the rolling sphere misses it entirely. The sphere still rolls down the incline and reaches the floor, but there is no collision and no topple.
